scope: bundled-device-parameters-v1 partial requirement clauses only (see spec.md)
fixture_origin: Independently authored device presets written from the parameter tables; no shipped file copied or excerpted
oracle_status: Documented and static-derived expectations; neither reference nor candidate executed

representation.paths: below the device element; groups joined by /
representation.action: open: open the device preset in a fresh state
representation.state: parameter values read when the preset opens; only listed keys are judged. Float: JSON number equal to the binary32 value; Enum: integer; Bool: true or false
representation.labels: text the user interface shows for the listed parameter's value; exact
representation.note: project comparison representation, not an API of the original application or a required design
